camera_repair: The four jump.apex stills were recaptured after actual review found the previous rear view behind a wall and front view behind the ladder. A separate review of the movie then found the platform hiding the jump feet/obstacle; only its jump camera was adjusted before re-recording the same real-time live cycle. The product, fixture, assets and controller physics were unchanged in both capture repairs.
